Terms of use and privacy policy

General

BizDb.co.nz (collectively referred to as the “Site” or "Website" in these Terms of Use) encourages the use of this Site as a way to obtain and share information and knowledge in support of the creators' mission to provide everyone with the high-quality information about businesses.

By accessing the Site, you agree to all terms, conditions, and notices contained or referenced herein (the “Terms of Use”). If you do not agree to these Terms of Use please do not use the Site. We reserve the right, at our discretion, to update or revise these Terms of Use. Please check the Terms of Use periodically for changes. Your continued use of the Site following the posting of any changes to the Terms of Use constitutes acceptance of those changes.

Privacy Statement

BizDb.co.nz collects information to improve functionality and content and to monitor performance. Data is used to help answer specific questions about the usage and performance of the individual web pages. Typically, Site usage is not associated with individual IP addresses. We at BizDb.co.nz recognise your right to confidentiality and are committed to protecting your privacy. The Site operates under the following set of strict privacy principles:

The only information BizDb.co.nz obtains about individual visitors to its Site is the one supplied voluntarily by visitors. In cases when The Site may need personal information to provide visitors with customized content or to inform them about new services or features, visitors are explicitly asked for that information.

Personally identifiable information provided by visitors (name, e-mail, etc.) will not be disclosed to anyone unless visitors indicate that BizDb.co.nz may do so.

Only statistical information about our visitors as a group (usage habits, demographics) may be shared with any partner of the Site. Personally identifiable information will not be shared at any time without the visitor's permission. Personal information is stored in a secured database and always sent via an encrypted Internet channel.

Cookies

The Site may place cookies in the browser files of your computer. Cookies are pieces of information that a website transfers to an individual's hard disk for record keeping purposes. BizDb.co.nz may use cookies during your online session to deliver content specific to your interests. Cookies allow us to avoid showing you the same ad or other message repeatedly. Cookies do not contain personal information. They do enable to relate your use of the Site to information that you have specifically and knowingly provided to our Site. Cookies don't affect the computer in any way, they don't affect any system configurations either. You can delete cookie files by choosing 'Remove cookies' option in your browser's settings. You can also block the usage of cookies by choosing the proper option in your browser's settings.
